title: Luxury Master Bathroom Remodel in Midlothian
summary: Complete master bathroom transformation featuring a custom walk-in shower, frameless glass, dual vanities, decorative tile, updated lighting and refined trim details.
problem: The existing bathroom had an outdated layout, aging finishes and a shower area that required full demolition before the new design could be built.
solution: Completed demolition, framing and plumbing preparation, then installed a custom tiled shower, bench, niche, frameless glass, new vanities, countertops, lighting, trim and finish work.
